fact: The CNDP announced it is strengthening its monitoring of inadequate publication of personal data on the darkweb with a tool supplied by DEFENDIS, and will alert the controllers concerned and apply the legal measures, notably where processing was not notified to it under Law 09-08.
title: اللجنة الوطنية لحماية المعطيات الشخصية تشدد اليقظة لمكافحة التسريبات الإلكترونية
